item.title: SHOT Show 26 – Irregular Defense Disruptive Hinterland Camo Pattern
item.description: Slayde showed off his upcoming Irregular Disruptive Hinterland camouflage pattern. The fabric has been printed and uniforms and individual equipment will begin rolling out starting this spring. www.scirregulars.com

item.title: SHOT Show 26 – Revelyst Project Freedom Updates Camelbak Packs
item.description: Camelbak which exhibited at SHOT Show along with the other brands under the Revelyst Project Freedom banner. Although are still not the final we should start seeing completely redesigned packs by next SHOT Show.

item.title: 2nd Marine Logistics Group Develops First Marine Corps NDAA Compliant 3D Printed Drone
item.description: MARINE CORPS BASE CAMP LEJEUNE, N.C. – Amidst the Department of War’s “Drone Dominance” intent to acquire 300,000 one-way attack drones by calendar year 2028, 2nd Marine Logistics Group has developed the Marine Corps’ first National Defense Authorizing Act-compliant 3D printed drone.
